selected_experts.reason: To confirm the objects are correctly classified as office binders and not similar rectangular objects like books or folders.
To rigorously analyze the illegible scribbles on the open binder's pages for character-level coherence failures.
To check for fusion artifacts between the metal rings and the paper holes, and ensure the papers are distinct entities.
To verify the physical grounding of the standing binders and detect any subtle floating or blending with the background surface.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text on loose-leaf papers
Physical interaction between metal rings and paper holes (fusion/occlusion)
Grounding and shadow consistency of standing binders
Structural integrity of the ring mechanism hinge
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In real images, even blurry handwriting has stroke logic. AI often generates 'texture that looks like text' without semantic structure. Also, scrutinize the ring mechanism: do the rings actually go *through* the paper, or do they just sit on top/fuse with it? This is a high-failure zone for AI physics.
